prior: Six independent physical Uniform distributions; source generator uses vectoruniform, no curveorientation constraint

selection.interpretation: Exploratory selection and geometry of the learned candidate; no independent reference claim
selection.primary_selection: Among strict interior cases, greatest absolute within-case Spearman among short/long/decay pairs; lowest ID breaks ties
selection.secondary_selection: Among remaining strict interior cases, greatest absolute eta/rho Spearman; lowest ID breaks ties
selection.near_flat_definition: abs(true long_variance minus true short_variance) <= .005 variance units
selection.near_flat_selection: Among near-flat cases with all six truths10percent inside bounds, largest decay90percent width/prior width; not an interior showcase
selection.nonlinearity: Descriptive additional R2 from a residualized quadratic predictor, in either direction; not a Gaussianity test

scope: All correlations computed within each observed case; no pooled posterior correlation. Quadratic/skew/CDF distances are descriptive learned-candidate diagnostics, not proof of nonGaussian true posteriors.
